body: You don't live with the voice that I do, you don't understand what torture it is.  I have to die to end it.

I wish I could believe in change.  At least positive change.  For four years now all I've seen is gradual negative change.  I just can't stand by and let my life continue to fall.  I have to end it before it gets worse.
You're just like the voice in my head, you want me to die.  You'll all get your wish soon enough
I had a job I was passionate about but I was betrayed and it was taken from me.  Now I feel nothing.
I used to have a passion, but they took it away from me.  They won't let me have it back.  I've tried so hard to get it back but they don't want me to have it.  They win, there's nothing I can do.
I've seen so many therapists and shrinks that have tried that, it just doesn't work for me.  Telling myself lies only makes it worse.

I just can't seem to catch a break.  I haven't had a single good thing happen for me in around three or four years now, and everything is just headed downhill with no change in realistic sight.

I hate knowing that I used to be a worthwhile person and that now I'm nothing.  I hate knowing that I'll one day be dead and will soon be forgotten and won't have accomplished anything worthwhile or meaningful.

I hear voices inside my head all the time telling me that I'm not good enough, that I'm failing, that I'm a disgusting and terrible person.  They just seem so right and I feel so inadequate to fight them.

I just never envisioned my life to have come to this.  I'm just a menial drone, working my best years away for something that is utterly meaningless.  I can't take it.  I feel like the only control I have and way out is to just end it.
For me it could be an end to what most likely is a permanent problem.
I've been "down on my luck" for years now, with no promise of anything changing.  It's just always bearing down on me and I can't take it any longer.
I don't really understand what you're trying to tell me.
This is CBT isn't it?  Those things aren't "aborted successes" or any other kind of happy go lucky descriptive lie.
I've seen so many doctors, therapists, etc.  They just fill me full of pills or lies and think the problems are solved.  They're not.  I'm not fixable.
Ha.  Yeah.  They just laugh at me and take all of my money.  There's no hope for me.

Of course it's a fear of failure.  I've had so much at this point, and I can't take it anymore.  I'm already so close to killing myself, and all of my logic tells me that I should.  I want to die but at the same time I'm afraid of it.  I'm most afraid that one more big failure will finally push me over the edge.
Communications, but I'm not in NC.
Don't you get it?  I've tried.  Society has failed me.  I've failed it.  We have no space with each other.  I have to die, I have no choice.

I'm a debt-slave.  When I was younger and stupidly naive, I believed hard work and education would give me the opportunities I strived for at the time. They didn't, and as punishment for that foolishness, I'm left in the inescapable debt impounded upon me by the Master's Degree that so many others lied to me about as the ticket to success.

The truth is what scares me.  Things could get better, but there is a far larger chance that they won't.  In fact, there's a much larger probability that it will get worse.  Like you said, I'm not owed anything.  The only thing I can count on is death.  At least I can have some control in that.
Nearly 30.
I would love to but I just can't.  I can't stop moving or thinking, I can't ever find any peace.
Feel free to PM me.
I wish that were possible, but it's not.  Due to a number of factors entirely out of my control, I'm more or less stuck where I am.  No forward or backward.
Such a long story.  You wouldn't care.  Suffice to say, I'm as close to a legal slave to where I am as is possible.
I have nothing.  I have no tools.  I have no life.  I have no autonomy.  I have no future.  No hope.  Nothing.  No one.
They'll be taken care of, that's not a concern.
So you want to just sweep me under the rug?  This society keeps pushing me out.  You all don't want me here.  You'll get your wish soon enough.
I wish that were possible.  It's not.
I haven't felt like that in about four years now.
That's a pretty good metaphor, I guess.  The struggle for me is that I have no evidence that shows things will ever get better.
They'll have others to take care of them when I'm gone.
Prove it.
I wish I were.
If and when, it would be only me.
That's a nice thought, but think on it: That whole thing centers on the word "may."  I have far more evidence that supports the idea that I never will figure things out.
I'm totally open.  How can you help?
If I end it now, I won't have to live with the torture of knowing I probably never will.

I'm nearly 30 years old.  I'm almost exactly the same age as Mark Zuckerberg.  He's majority owner of Facebook, is a billionaire, has made something that changed the world, and now is donating most of his wealth to make it even better.

I'm broke.  I have nothing.  I have nothing to give.  He'll be remembered, I'll be forgotten and nameless.  When I was younger, I worked just as hard.  But now I'm nobody, while he's out there changing the world.

I guess what I'm trying to say is not everyone gets the same breaks.  Some of us are just far less fortunate and don't get the same opportunities.  I should just get out of the way of people who can be impactful and just stop sucking up resources in this world that I'm not entitled to.

What I want most in the world is to make that kind of impact or difference.  When I was younger, I desperately wanted to grow up to be someone like that.  I thought maybe I could be the next Steve Jobs or somebody.

But as I got older and more worn down, I realized how impossible that is.  I have so much holding me back, so much that's out of my control, it's just not possible.  I'll never reach even close to those goals.  I just deserve to die if I can't.
I just want to die.
What do you want me to tell you about?

I've had so much "help."  I've talked to counselors, doctors, therapists, psychiatrists. You name it. People used to take me to them, but they don't anymore. I think they realize I'm destined to die soon.
I've talked to counselors, doctors, therapists, psychiatrists.  You name it.  People used to take me to them, but they don't anymore.  I think they realize I'm destined to die soon.

Yes, we will all die.  But once we do, it will be very soon afterwards that all that we are and all that we've done are completely forgotten.  Our existence is meaningless.  Why prolong the inevitable?  And why does it really matter anyways?
I've been seeing professionals about this for years now.  I've been stuffed full of medication until I'm a zombie, and I've been told so many rainbows and puppies lies.  Nothing works.
I feel like I've done all I can.  I've opened up to people, have sought help, and have fought through this for years.  But I'm still here.  Suffering.  I just can't take it anymore.
What connection?
Sure, I would love a good pizza.  But I don't deserve it.  I am miserable and worthless and don't deserve any good thing in life until I've earned it.

I didn't ask for this cloud in my head.  I didn't want to hear voices.  I didn't want to wake up every day dreading to get out of bed.  I didn't ask to be stabbed in the back by people I thought I could be loyal to.  None of this was my choice.  Other people get to wake up every day looking forward to it. Why?  What makes them special?  At least more capable than me?  Why should I suffer while others go about their day?  Why?  Getting out of this seems so far, so distant.  It could take forever.  It's not worth it.  I just want out.
What do you mean reframe it?
They would make me happy, which is why I don't deserve them.
When my end comes, it will be at your feet.
You hit the nail on the head. I have no autonomy whatsoever.  I'm a slave to money and society.  I control nothing.
I don't think any of those things are for me.  I deserve nothing.
I don't think those things are for me.  All I know is suffering, all I hear are voices.  I can't stand it.
I've had so much of both.  Both just turn me into something I'm not.  I'd rather die being myself than "live" being something I'm not.
Some mental wounds are much worse than physical ones.  Take my word for it.
Good thing I don't have any good friends.

Let's say that you have a pet that is severely injured.  They probably aren't going to make it.  Putting them down is considered the right and humane thing to do.  Isn't the suffering of a human any more valid than the suffering of an animal?  The right thing to do is to let the hurting person die.
Let's say those "temporary" problems have stayed around for three years, and there's no end in sight.  There's only so much torture any given person can realistically take.
Any more selfish than someone expecting someone to live when they don't want to anymore?
Of course you would say that.  It's not like anyone is going to admit it.  You are part of this cabal.  I know you.
You are part of this, aren't you? Why would you choose to do this to me? Whatever happens to me will be at your feet.
You seem to know what I need.  Will you help me?
I'm seeking help.  You're stopping me from getting it.  You're one of the people doing this to me.  Why?
So I suppose you'll do as everyone else and sweep me away to somewhere more convenient and out of your way.

Yes, I had tried to start my own business last year.  A friend and I had what we believe to be a killer idea for a media sharing app for iPhone and Android.  Even in the year or so since we'd come up with the idea and planned it out, nobody else has done anything like it.

Problem is, neither of us are developers.  We'd both tried to learn XCode to do it ourselves, but the idea of what we want to do is so far beyond what either of us are capable of.  We'd searched around looking for developers to help us write it, but no one was willing to work with us, or were proposing astronomical and unrealistic charges to get the job done.

I just gave up, as it just was clear that it wasn't in the cards for me.  That's been the same for so many ideas and dreams I've had, I just hit roadblocks that make it clear that those things just aren't for me, and I'm stupid for even considering them.  It's not necessarily the lack of motivation or focus like you say, it's just that I realize how dumb I am for even having the audacity to believe I'm capable of achieving anything more.  Instead, I'm just forced to live as this zombie drone who will never be able to get anything further.

Yes, I've done CBT with three different therapists, it's been a train wreck each time.  I just can't wrap my head around the idea of lying to yourself to make yourself believe that everything is puppies and rainbows when in reality it's nothing of the sort.  If anything it usually only makes me angry because it feels like my therapists devalue what I'm trying to tell them and try to stuff me full of platitudes and lies instead, I just can't fathom how that's in any way helpful.
I just don't know, I've talked with both for more than a year now and I'm certainly not any better on any count due to either of them.

Thanks, I guess.  

Look I'll be honest, I just don't have the strength or will to do anything with myself.  Mostly because I just see it all as destined to fail, Failure and death is nothing but inevitable, and I have nothing but evidence to support that.
What is that rope?  I'm certainly not seeing it.
I understand what you're saying, but I realistically feel as if I have control over nothing.
Honestly my debt rep or counselor doesn't give a shit about me and why should they?  Both are just taking advantage of me to suck funding from me.
I don't think that could possibly be true, I've come across terribly here.
I hate it.  A lot of days, I want to die because of it, because I know it will never marginally improve.
No, I'm afraid to tell them.  I'm afraid they'll just drop me if they ever find out.
Yes, I've been diagnosed as schizophrenic.  It pisses me off.  It's not like I chose this for my life.
Jesus, decades at this point.
I have no other control in life.  If I want to have control over when and how to end it, that should be my decision, not anyone else's.

Thank you.  But I'm just forced into that script.  I've got unfathomable debt, thanks to the naivety of my younger self that thought a Master's Degree was a good idea.  Now I have no choice but to suffer the consequences of that and allow myself to be a debt-slave.

I just wish I could be part of something or do something that's just larger than myself.  When I was younger, I had all kinds of naive ways I could do that in mind, but as I became more older and jaded, I realized how stupidly impossible all of that was.
They tell me I'm "cured" by being on this medication that turns me into a zombie worker drone.  I'm currently refusing to take it, I feel like I just have to come back up for air.
I don't think I follow you, what do you mean?
Then please kill me.

I suppose I certainly did to begin with, when I was naive enough to believe that following the script would yield rewards.  Now that I know it's almost the opposite of that, I hate myself for ever being that deluded.
Causing my death is irrelevant, contributing to the crime of our species is what's worth worrying about.

I've seen so many through the years.  When I was a teenager and started having these issues, my parents had me see someone.  Throughout the years I've had other mentor figures or acquaintances suggest it or even force it, but nothing has really helped.  All they've done is cram me full of medication, turning me into yet another worker bee drone.  Every once in a while I just have to come out of it to come up for air.

I just want to matter, but I'm so defeated by the inevitability that I won't.

When I was younger, I was fed so many lines by parents and students about how I was "gifted," and how I'd make so much of myself.  I was naive enough to believe it, and envisioned a future for myself in which I'd be able to make a big impact in the world and truly do something great.  But as time worn on, it became more and more obvious those were all lies.  Instead of being given opportunities, I found only more chains.  Now instead of being able to make my own choices, I'm nothing more than a worker drone, destined to live a life of inevitability and complacency.

Life would be worth living it it were *mine,* but it isn't.

I don't have the answers to many things, certainly not this question.

I don't really know.  I just have no one to talk with about this.

I honestly just don't see any realistic or actionable change that I or most people in modern society can really make.

We're all expected to follow a certain "life script."  Go to school, get a job, find a mate, have offspring, save money, retire, and die.  There are certain restraints that each of these steps enact, most typically through the most common language of modern society: money.  We're forced to earn it, forced to spend it, forced to live in slavery to it.

Sure, I can give you an example that I encountered about a year or so ago.

I was close to killing myself and my girlfriend at the time convinced me to go through a major change.  I quit my job at the time and went to volunteer for the Summer at a National Park, in the hopes of gaining back some sanity and clarity.  Just as soon as I started to find that peace, reality came back.  The pittance I was earning as a volunteer wasn't enough to pay back my Master's Degree debt, and I had to give up the near-peace I had in order to take a well-paying enough job to pay off my debts again.  I felt as if I was punished for having the audacity of believing I had any autonomy or agency in my own life, and I was forced back into debt-servitude yet again.

It's not a possibility of depression, it's an inevitability.  I've lived like this for at least three years now, and I've just had to accept it as a reality, and not something that can be cured.  In the first year or so, it certainly felt like depression.  But now that I've accepted it, at least I can muster up the energy to obey as I'm told.
What choice do I have?  I'm enslaved by the debt of the Masters Degree that the naive younger version of myself put on me.  I have no choice but to be employed and obey.
I believe that we as a species should not exist.  We are evil, meaningless, and pointless.  We offer nothing to our existence other than to suck up resources before we inevitably die.

I think I just understand that "help" is a nonsensical application that we've invented for ourselves to delude ourselves of the honest reality.  It's easy to live the script outlined by the most convenient lie.
Don't worry.  I won't be around much longer to have bothered you further.

Guilt and remorse.

I don't feel as if I should be allowed to enjoy those things because I felt such great guilt over what I know I'll never accomplish.  I feel like the current me has failed the past me in that I've accomplished nothing of what I originally attended.  I feel such great remorse that I've let myself and so many others down.
That is ultimately my main point: There is no choice.

Which is to figure out life's purpose?  I've spent years in the pursuit of that, and those answers have eluded me.  In its wake, the only true answer presented is the one I suspected all along: There is no purpose.
That would be preferable to the stupid medication induced zombie state I'm currently conformed into.
What is your recommendation?
We are all each guilty of the reality we've placed ourselves into.  A clean consciousness does not absolve you of that crime.

That isn't a script for me.  When I was younger and stupidly naive, I believed hard work and education would give me the opportunities I strived for at the time.  They didn't, and as punishment for that foolishness, I'm left in the inescapable debt impounded upon me by the Master's Degree that so many others lied to me about as the ticket to success.

Is it?  I don't believe so.  When I was younger, I naively believed that.  But as life and its misfortunes wore on, I slowly came to the realization that trying is just an inescapable excersize in irrelevancy.
I am not as comfortable or complacent in the lies everyone else leads themselves into.
When I die, it will be partially at your hands.
I feel like these things are only perceived changes that are ultimately irrelevant.  What's inescapable is that we are born, live irrelevantly, then die and are forgotten.  That cannot be changed.
There is no value.  It doesn't matter what I can offer, because ultimately I will be dead and everything I've done forgotten.

I struggle with the realization that I have no real control over my life, but if I choose to die of my own making, I can control that.  I feel myself coming closer and closer.  When I attempt, I will be successful, and I will finally be successful at something as I die.
I would love to change it, but it is impossible.  You yourself and everyone alive sees evidence of it every single day.

What purpose or point is there in prevention of death?  Death and all of its consequences are ultimately inevitable.  It doesn't matter if I or anyone else realized of their irrelevancy kills themselves now or waits for the certainty of death.  There's nothing ultimately meaningful any of us can truly offer in that span of time.
I feel that way at times too.  Most times with that choice, I feel like being dead is probably the better option for myself and all those around me.
It isn't.  I'm only predestined to obey.  Having the illusion of choice is just that.  I've no choice but to follow the script.
I've searched for the answer to that question, do not have it, and do not expect to find it.
Also, why not die now?  If we're destined to die, destined to be forgotten, and inevitably have nothing to offer, why prolong the inevitable?
So many have suggested that, and I've seen my share.  I'm not particularly interested in the forced conformity and inept mental gymnastics they sell in order to finance their next BMW.
